paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Loss comparison of Ex1 and Ex2 during the Embedding and LM Head training stage.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the loss values across a range of steps. The x-axis is labeled "Step" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60000, with tick labels at intervals of 10000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and has a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^1 to 10^1.2, with tick labels at 10^1, 10^1.1, and 10^1.2. A blue solid line labeled "Ex1 Loss" starts at a value of approximately 1.1 x 10^1 at step 0, declines to approximately 2.1 x 10^0 at step 30000, and remains relatively steady around 2.0 x 10^0 at step 60000. A magenta solid line labeled "Ex2 Loss" starts at a value of approximately 1.1 x 10^1 at step 0, declines to approximately 2.1 x 10^0 at step 30000, and remains relatively steady around 2.0 x 10^0 at step 60000. A cyan dashed line labeled “Ex1 Validation Loss” begins at approximately 1.1 x 10^1 at step 0, descends to approximately 3.5 x 10^0 at step 10000, and plateaus around 3.7 x 10^0 at step 60000. A magenta dashed line labeled "Ex2 Validation Loss" starts at approximately 1.1 x 10^1 at step 0, remains relatively stable around 3.7 x 10^0 throughout the plot.
